question: Tell me about EGSPEC
answer: E. G. S. Pillay Engineering College (EGSPEC) is an autonomous engineering institution in Nagapattinam established in 1995 by the G. S. Pillay & Sons Charitable and Educational Trust. It is affiliated with Anna University, recognized by the UGC under Sections 2(f) and 12(B), and accredited with NAAC A++. The official history records 11 undergraduate and 9 postgraduate programs, with recognized research centres in Mechanical Engineering, EEE, ECE, CSE, and Civil Engineering.

question: Which courses are NBA accredited and what is their scope?
answer: The official EGSPEC accreditation page currently lists eight NBA-accredited programs. Valid up to 30 June 2028: B.E. Computer Science and Engineering (CSE), B.Tech. Information Technology (IT), and B.E. Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE). Valid up to 30 June 2027: B.E. Mechanical Engineering, B.E. Civil Engineering, and B.E. Electrical and Electronics Engineering (EEE). Valid up to 31 December 2028: B.E. Biomedical Engineering (BME) and the postgraduate MCA program. Typical career scope: CSE—software engineering, AI/data, cloud and cybersecurity; IT—application development, cloud, networks and information security; ECE—embedded systems, VLSI, communication, electronics and IoT; Mechanical—design, manufacturing, automotive, robotics and energy; Civil—construction, structural engineering, infrastructure, surveying and environmental work; EEE—power systems, renewable energy, industrial automation, control systems and electric vehicles; BME—medical devices, clinical engineering, healthcare technology and biomedical research; MCA—software/application development, data systems, cloud and IT consulting. NBA accredits the specific program, not every program in the institution, and accreditation does not by itself guarantee a placement.
